messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "treatment will need to be changed carefully"
set: ["treatment will need to be changed carefully", "doctor will periodically reassess need to continue treatment", "patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment", "reassessment determines need for ongoing treatment", "dose may need to be adjusted as diet changes", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the continued need of maintenance treatment", "kidney function may need to be checked before taking", "does not need to be tapered like a steroid", "dose will be increased slowly to minimise gastrointestinal side effects", "your doctor will need to check your progress on a regular basis", "day of weekly administration can be changed if necessary", "need to consult doctor for long-term treatment and vitamin B-12 concerns", "doctor will determine right dose based on condition and response to treatment", "review should determine the need for maintenance treatment", "child should be monitored during treatment", "will not be as effective in lowering cholesterol"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
